{{Quote|I represent a lab. One of our competitors has created something interesting and I want samples of their discoveries. I need you to go and collect the blood from some creatures.|Stregand, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:EB" />}}
'''Stregand''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he represented a corporate lab specialized in biotechnologies.<ref name="SWG:EB" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Stregand went to [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] after he learnt the existence of an [[Illegal Lab (Corellia)|illegal lab]] on the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]],<ref name="SWG:EB" /> a lab specialized in [[Bioengineering/Legends|bio-engineering]] creatures through dangerous genetic experiments.<ref name="SWG:CMAoD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Coronet Murmurs: Agents of Destruction|Corellia}}</ref> Stregand hired a spacer to steal some samples of blood from the engineered creatures in order to copy the process for his own corporation.<ref name="SWG:EB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Stregand was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:EB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Stregand was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 28 Notes for April 26, 2006|Publish 28]]," on [[April 26]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref>
